Frequently Asked Questions

Clear, anatomically sound answers vetted by professional bra fitters.

Can two people with a 38-inch bust wear different bra sizes? ▾

Absolutely! A person with a 30-inch underbust and a 38-inch bust wears a 30G. A person with a 34-inch underbust and a 38-inch bust wears a 34D. A person with a 36-inch underbust and a 38-inch bust wears a 36B.
